label: A CAUSE_OF_BEING_2 sustainer of all is present to all, from the contact principle (inference)
rule: Instantiate the sustaining clause at the moment the other thing is present, then the contact principle at that giving
meaning: Let g sustain (CAUSE_OF_BEING_2) every other thing present at some moment of history v, and let x, other than g, be present at t. Since x is present at some moment, g sustains x, so g gives x being at t; by the contact principle g is present at t. Hence g is present, and giving x being, whenever x is. A short derivation from one open premise. The controls do not check this statement directly; they check the composed IMMENSE_2 presence route, where the contact principle is needed (Control part 2) and an originating cause in place of a sustaining one does not suffice (part 1). No premise is established.
